metadata.description: Local time (SE Asia Standard Time). Set to DailyRoutineStartDate 21:00 (FSD 16.2)

properties.description: Generic dataset (SQL Server connector, linked service Agus_SqlServer_dwh) for Lookup and Copy activities that call schema ret procedures (no table bound).

One Parquet file per table and business date: <container>/<yyyy>/<BlobPath>/<BlobPath>_<yyyyMMdd>.parquet, BlobPath = lower-case <schema>.<table>; FolderPath and FileName come from ret.RetentionArchiveDate (SQL v0.6 ret.fn_ArchiveFolderPath / ret.fn_ArchiveFileName) (FR-007, MD-07).
Archive folder (binary) for Get Metadata (child items) and Delete activities (FR-013, FR-018).

FSD 4.18 / 5.4 / 6.1: remove exactly the archive files that this table log wrote, as listed by ret.usp_GetRunArchiveFiles (layout MD-07, no RunId in the file name), then record the result with ret.usp_LogCleanupResult (success: dates marked REMOVED; failure: orphan-file flag, ERR-EXP-03).

activities.name: LKP_GetRunArchiveFiles
activities.description: FSD 4.18: files this table log may have written (ExportStatus SUCCEEDED, FAILED or STOPPED).

activities.name: FE_DeleteRunFiles
activities.description: One file per business date; a missing folder means the file was never written.

ifTrueActivities.name: DEL_RunFile
ifTrueActivities.description: Deletes exactly one file of this run: <FolderPath>/<FileName> from ret.RetentionArchiveDate (no pattern; files of other runs are never touched).

value.value: @concat('One or more archive files of this run could not be deleted (', pipeline().parameters.BlobPath, '). ADF run ', pipeline().RunId)

properties.description: Option B: export one chunk of business dates (up to N) in parallel, one Parquet file per date, each result recorded with ret.usp_LogExportResult. Called by PL_RETB_03E for every chunk.

activities.name: FE_ExportDates
activities.description: Option B: the dates of one chunk in parallel (batchCount 16 = upper bound; the chunk size N from ret.usp_GetExportChunk sets the real parallelism). No variables inside (not safe in a parallel ForEach): every result is recorded in SQL by ret.usp_LogExportResult.

activities.name: CPY_ExportBusinessDate
activities.description: IC-02 / DR-02: rows of one business date -> one Parquet file <FolderPath>/<FileName> (MD-07). Source ret.usp_ExportSourceRows (all columns, ordinal order, no transformation).

activities.name: LKP_LogExport_Succeeded
activities.description: Records rows read / written per date (input of usp_ValidateArchive); IC: window check (ERR-WIN-01).

activities.name: LKP_LogExport_Failed
activities.description: ERR-EXP-01: Copy failed after retries; the chunk fails, the loop in PL_RETB_03E stops.

properties.description: Option B (FR-006 / FR-007 / FR-019, IC-02, DR-02, RB-06): export every PENDING business date of a table log, chunk by chunk; each chunk of N dates is exported in parallel by PL_RETB_03G (N = ExportParallelism).

activities.name: UNT_ExportChunks
activities.description: One iteration per chunk of N dates. ret.usp_GetExportChunk decides (status, failed dates, IC window) and returns the next N PENDING dates; the loop ends after the chunk with RemainingAfterChunk = 0, or when ContinueExport = 0, or on an error.

ifTrueActivities.name: SET_Continue_ChunkError
ifTrueActivities.description: A date of the chunk failed (Copy or log): stop; this run's files are removed.

activities.name: IF_CleanupOnStop
activities.description: Batch-delete path: remove this run's files on export failure or window stop (E2). Rebuild path passes CleanupOnStop = false: usp_TableRebuildAbort runs first (SQL contract).

properties.description: PRC-02 batch-delete path (IC-01..IC-04a) and PRC-03 (DR-02..DR-04), option B: export (chunks) -> validate + batch delete + post-check in one Lookup; this run's files are removed when validation fails (FR-018).

activities.name: IF_ExportRequired
activities.description: NextAction VALIDATE (IC, expired rows only, DBR-03) skips the export.

activities.name: LKP_ValidateDeleteAndCheck
activities.description: Option B, one Lookup: usp_ValidateArchive (BR-08 gate) -> usp_BatchDelete only when PASSED -> usp_PostCheck only when COMPLETED. Always called after the export step (a failed export makes the validation FAIL, so nothing is removed). Retry 0: the deletion is never repeated by ADF.

activities.name: IF_CleanupRequired
activities.description: E3: validation failure or ERR-VAL-02 -> remove this run's files; nothing removed from the DWH.

activities.name: LKP_GetCleanupDecision
activities.description: Unexpected error: files may be removed only while no row was deleted (fail-safe, BR-08).

properties.description: FR-010 / Section 8.4 table rebuild (Initial Cut-off Run, method TABLE_REBUILD, downtime reference required): Prepare (RB-01..05) -> export from original (RB-06) -> validate (RB-07) -> Swap (RB-07..10) -> post-check; Abort + file cleanup on any failure before the swap commits.

activities.name: LKP_RebuildPrepare
activities.description: RB-01..RB-05 (MD-04 steps 1-2): checks, new table <table>__RBD_<RunId> with the retained rows, keys/constraints/indexes, count check. Original table unchanged.

activities.name: IF_ExportRequired
activities.description: RB-06 (MD-04 step 3): archived segment exported from the ORIGINAL table.

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_RebuildSwap
ifTrueActivities.description: RB-07 recount, RB-08 truncate + drop + rename in one transaction (MD-04 steps 4-5, MD-06, DEC-13), RB-09 reseed / view refresh, RB-10 definition check.

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_RebuildAbort
ifTrueActivities.description: Any failure before RB-08 commits: drop the new table, revoke validation, request file cleanup.

properties.description: FR-017 / PRC-05: resume validated batch-delete ranges of earlier runs, oldest first, until none is pending. A non-COMPLETED result stops the loop; the table log status set by ret.usp_BatchDelete then blocks further steps.

activities.name: LKP_BatchDelete_Resume
activities.description: Removes the remaining rows of a validated range of an earlier run without export (DBR-09).

activities.name: IF_UnexpectedError

message.value: @concat('Resume of a validated range failed: ', variables('vUnexpectedError'))

activities.description: Only an ADF/connection error fails the pipeline; FAILED/STOPPED results are already recorded by the procedure.

properties.description: Per-table data steps after usp_BeginTableAndIdentify returned PROCEED: (resume -> identify) -> batch-delete path or table-rebuild path (IC only) -> post-check.

activities.name: IF_PendingResume

ifTrueActivities.name: LKP_IdentifyEligibleData
ifTrueActivities.description: Only after a resume (FSD 4.17); otherwise usp_BeginTableAndIdentify already identified.

activities.description: FR-017: resume pending ranges before new data is identified. Without a pending range the identify result comes from usp_BeginTableAndIdentify (option B, no extra Lookup).

activities.name: SW_ProcessingPath
activities.description: BATCH: Daily Routine or IC with BATCH_DELETE. REBUILD: IC with TABLE_REBUILD (BR-11). IC_NODATA: IC without eligible rows - post-check only, so the table reaches COMPLETED. NONE: nothing eligible (DR) or the step before failed (status already recorded).

properties.description: FSD 4.13 / 5.4 / DR-05, option B: delete archive data with business date before the archive cut-off (layout MD-07): year folders <yyyy>/<BlobPath> before the cut-off year and files of the cut-off year dated before the cut-off, decided by one Lookup (ret.usp_GetExpiredArchiveItems). A missing folder is a no-op.

activities.name: GMD_ListYearFolders
activities.description: Container root: year folders <yyyy>.

activities.name: GMD_ListCutoffYearFiles
activities.description: Folder <archive cut-off year>/<BlobPath>; a missing folder returns exists = false.

activities.name: LKP_GetExpiredArchiveItems
activities.description: Option B: both levels in one Lookup (usp_GetExpiredArchiveFolders YEAR + FILE). DELETE rows only; non-matching names are never deleted.

activities.name: FE_DeleteExpiredItems
activities.description: Parallel, batch 4 (FSD 6.1). The year folder is shared by all tables, so the table folder may not exist.

ifTrueActivities.name: DEL_ExpiredItem
ifTrueActivities.description: YEAR: whole folder <yyyy>/<BlobPath> (recursive). FILE: one file <BlobPath>_<yyyyMMdd>.parquet.

value.value: @concat('ERR-ARC-01: one or more expired items could not be deleted (', pipeline().parameters.BlobPath, '). ADF run ', pipeline().RunId)

properties.description: PL-03 per table, option B: usp_BeginTableAndIdentify -> data steps (PL_RETB_03A) -> expired archive deletion (PL_RETB_04, Daily Routine) -> usp_EndTable (always).

activities.name: LKP_BeginTableAndIdentify
activities.description: Option B, one Lookup: usp_BeginTable (table log, lock, checks V-01..V-11, gates, pending resume) and, when PROCEED, not VALIDATION and no pending resume, usp_IdentifyEligibleData (snapshot, D-1).

activities.name: IF_Proceed
activities.description: Dry validation (ValidateOnly = true, process type VALIDATION, decision D-3) stops after the checks; nothing is exported or deleted.

activities.name: IF_ArchiveExpiry
activities.description: DR-05 runs whenever V-05 and V-06 passed, whatever happened earlier (BR-14, PRC-03 E1-E4).

activities.name: LKP_EndTable
activities.description: IC-05 / DR-06 / FR-014: always called; final status, IC status on failure/stop, lock release.

activities.name: IF_TableFailed

message.value: @concat(pipeline().parameters.SchemaName, '.', pipeline().parameters.TableName, ' ended ', activity('LKP_EndTable').output.firstRow.FinalStatus, ' (', string(coalesce(activity('LKP_EndTable').output.firstRow?.ErrorCode, 'no code')), '). See ret.RetentionTableLog TableLogId ', string(activity('LKP_BeginTableAndIdentify').output.firstRow.TableLogId), '.')

activities.description: Makes a failed table visible in ADF monitoring; the master continues with the next table.

properties.description: PL-01 / PRC-02 / FR-011: Initial Cut-off Run, triggered manually inside 21:00-05:00 UTC+7 (BR-17). TableConfigIdList EMPTY = automatic mode (CR-01, SQL v0.5): all active tables not yet COMPLETED, SMALL/MEDIUM before LARGE, child tables first; run again until every table is COMPLETED. TableConfigIdList given = explicit ordered list. LARGE or TABLE_REBUILD tables require DowntimeReference (BR-16, D-07). Concurrency 1. ValidateOnly = true: dry validation (process type VALIDATION, decision D-3, FSD 4.2 / 4.11): checks V-01..V-11 only, nothing exported or deleted, DowntimeReference ignored; empty TableConfigIdList = all active tables not COMPLETED.

activities.name: LKP_StartRunAndGetTables

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC ret.usp_StartRunAndGetTables @ProcessType = ''', if(bool(pipeline().parameters.ValidateOnly), 'VALIDATION', 'INITIAL_CUTOFF'), ''', @TriggerType = ''', if(equals(pipeline().TriggerType, 'ScheduleTrigger'), 'SCHEDULE', 'MANUAL'), ''', @AdfPipelineRunId = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @RunDate = ', if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.RunDate, ''))), 'NULL', concat('''', formatDateTime(if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.RunDate, ''))), '1900-01-01', trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.RunDate, ''))), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '''')), ', @TriggeredBy = ', concat('N''', replace(if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy, ''))), concat(pipeline().TriggerType, ': ', pipeline().TriggerName), trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy, ''))), '''', ''''''), ''''), ', @DowntimeReference = ', if(bool(pipeline().parameters.ValidateOnly), 'NULL', if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.DowntimeReference, ''))), 'NULL', concat('N''', replace(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.DowntimeReference, '')), '''', ''''''), ''''))), ', @TableConfigIdList = ', if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.TableConfigIdList, ''))), 'NULL', concat('N''', replace(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.TableConfigIdList, '')), '''', ''''''), '''')), ';')

activities.description: Option B, one Lookup: usp_StartRun (run record, run date UTC+7, idempotent per ADF run ID) + usp_GetTablesToProcess (FR-004). One row per table; one row with TableConfigId NULL when none. A selection error closes the run (FAILED) in SQL and fails this activity.

activities.name: SET_ProcessType
activities.description: Process type as recorded by usp_StartRun (VALIDATION when ValidateOnly = true).

activities.name: FE_Tables
activities.description: Sequential (DEC-07). A failed table never blocks the next one.

activities.name: LKP_EndRun
activities.description: FR-014: closes the run; raises an error (pipeline FAILED) when the run is not SUCCEEDED [REC 8.3].

properties.description: PL-02 / PRC-03 / FR-012: Daily Routine, scheduled every day 21:00 UTC+7 (BR-18). Selects active tables whose Initial Cut-off Run completed before the run date, from DailyRoutineStartDate (FR-020). RunDate empty = today UTC+7; manual rerun may pass an earlier date (DBR-15). Concurrency 1.

activities.name: LKP_StartRunAndGetTables

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('EXEC ret.usp_StartRunAndGetTables @ProcessType = ''', 'DAILY_ROUTINE', ''', @TriggerType = ''', if(equals(pipeline().TriggerType, 'ScheduleTrigger'), 'SCHEDULE', 'MANUAL'), ''', @AdfPipelineRunId = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', @RunDate = ', if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.RunDate, ''))), 'NULL', concat('''', formatDateTime(if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.RunDate, ''))), '1900-01-01', trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.RunDate, ''))), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), '''')), ', @TriggeredBy = ', concat('N''', replace(if(empty(trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy, ''))), concat(pipeline().TriggerType, ': ', pipeline().TriggerName), trim(coalesce(pipeline().parameters.TriggeredBy, ''))), '''', ''''''), ''''), ', @DowntimeReference = ', 'NULL', ', @TableConfigIdList = ', 'NULL', ';')

activities.description: Option B, one Lookup: usp_StartRun (run record, run date UTC+7, idempotent per ADF run ID) + usp_GetTablesToProcess (FR-004). One row per table; one row with TableConfigId NULL when none. A selection error closes the run (FAILED) in SQL and fails this activity.

activities.name: SET_ProcessType
activities.description: Process type as recorded by usp_StartRun (VALIDATION when ValidateOnly = true).

activities.name: FE_Tables
activities.description: Sequential (DEC-07). A failed table never blocks the next one.

activities.name: LKP_EndRun
activities.description: FR-014: closes the run; raises an error (pipeline FAILED) when the run is not SUCCEEDED [REC 8.3].

properties.description: BR-18: Daily Routine every day at 21:00 UTC+7 (SE Asia Standard Time). Deployed STOPPED: start it only after ret.usp_ActivateDailyRoutine (FSD 16.2, FR-020).
